name: The Missing Diplomat

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you follow the missing diplomat's trail into an underworld linking Stormwind's political circles to the Wetlands docks.
As a rogue, you know that operatives and handlers like Elling Trias rely on quiet legwork and street contacts to find those who slip through the cracks.

faq.answer: Slim is a shady contact in Menethil Harbor whom you catch during the search for the missing diplomat. Local contacts are surprised to learn he was involved.
Elling Trias is an influential figure in Stormwind City who keeps an underground network of former rogues and informants across Alliance lands.
You follow this part of the investigation in Menethil Harbor, a Wetlands port connecting Ironforge to distant shores and Stormwind trade routes.
faq.q: Where does this part of the investigation take place?

faq.answer: You investigate the disappearance of an important Stormwind envoy, following covert operatives, conspirators, and underworld contacts across the kingdom and beyond.
faq.q: What is the Missing Diplomat quest chain about?

faq.answer: A Menethil Harbor contact once worked with Elling Trias in Stormwind's underground circles. He avoids telling Elling that he misses the old life, for fear Elling will summon him back to the capital.
faq.q: Why does the contact warn against mentioning this to Elling?

faq.answer: You follow leads to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands and catch Slim. The encounter confirms local suspicions about illicit underground activity in town.
faq.q: What happened with the investigation in Menethil Harbor?

sections.body: You follow the missing Stormwind envoy's trail north to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Its docks and taverns hide shady dealers and covert runners, all working under the local guard's nose. To follow the leads through this port, you must deal with people who know the darker side of Alliance territory.
sections.title: Undercurrents in Menethil Harbor

sections.body: Catching Slim brings a sudden answer to the search. Local informants are surprised to learn he was entangled in the affair. His capture gives you critical answers, but it also stirs old memories for retired operatives in the Wetlands. They must weigh helping the Crown against being drawn back into Stormwind's underworld schemes.
sections.title: A Familiar Rogue

summary: Stormwind's envoy is missing, and you follow the trail from the capital to Menethil Harbor. There, the inquiry crosses paths with underworld figures and operatives tied to Stormwind's intelligence network.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Diplomat
